hints.title: Digit Sum Mapping
hints.text: Extract each digit using modulo 10 and integer division by 10 to compute digit sums.

hints.title: Running Minimum
hints.text: Track the minimum digit sum seen across all elements in the array.

hints.title: Single Pass Scan
hints.text: Iterate through nums once and return the minimum computed digit sum.
